meta_description: A private tutor for the course you follow in class.
settings_language_help: The language of buttons, menus and messages. Célestin keeps talking to you in the language of your course.
settings_language_error: Your language could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
auth_login_subtitle: Sign in to pick up your session.
auth_register_subtitle: Create your account to get started with Célestin.
setup_subtitle: Create the administrator account for this instance. You will add the OpenAI key next.
auth_name_too_long: Please use a shorter first name.
auth_password_too_short: Your password must be at least {min} characters long.
auth_password_rule: At least {min} characters. Not your first name or your email address.
error_generic: Célestin can't be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
error_invalid_request: Célestin couldn't handle this session. Reload the page to start a new one.
error_page_not_found_hint: It may have been moved. Head back to your courses.
error_page_failed_hint: Something went wrong on our side. Try again, or head back to your courses.
error_card_not_found_hint: This course or chapter doesn't exist, or it isn't yours.
error_not_yet_body: Your account has the role “{role}”. For now, only students can work with Célestin.
courses_load_failed: Couldn't load your courses. Try again in a moment.
courses_empty: You don't have any courses yet. Create one for each subject, then add the chapters your teacher gave you: Célestin will help you learn them.
course_empty: This course doesn't have any chapters yet. Add one with the PDF or photos of your course.
course_resume_title: Pick up where you left off
course_add_hint: Drop a PDF or photos of your course's pages.
course_name_length: The name must be between 1 and 80 characters long.
course_create_name_too_long: Please use a shorter name (80 characters at most).
course_create_failed: The course couldn't be created. Try again.
course_create_subject_locked: The subject can't be changed afterwards.
course_create_language_hint: The language your course is written in: Célestin will teach in it.
course_create_language_locked: The language can't be changed afterwards.
chapter_add_intro: Drop in the course just as your teacher gave it to you. Célestin reads the pages, then turns them into a chapter you follow step by step, in a few minutes.
chapter_delete_description: The course text, the prepared content and your progress on this chapter will be erased. This can't be undone.
chapter_status_here: this is where you left off
chapter_card_reading_hint: {progress} Then Célestin organises the content and builds the path. It takes a few minutes.
chapter_card_preparing_hint: Célestin organises the content and builds the path. It takes a minute or two.
chapter_retry_failed: The preparation couldn't be restarted. Try again.
content_generating_new: New version being prepared… The content below stays in use in the meantime.
content_generating_first: This chapter is being prepared. Its content will appear here in a minute or two.
content_source_unread: The pages haven't been read yet.
content_locked: You can edit it once the preparation is finished.
content_pack_hint: Keep the numbered headings “## 1. …” as they are, and the exercises in the form “#### 6.1.1”: the path refers to them.
content_reset_warning: The path of this chapter will start over from the beginning: your progress will be reset.
content_stale: The chapter has changed in the meantime. Reload it before saving: your unsaved changes will be lost.
content_source_warning: Célestin will prepare the chapter again from this text. The current content stays usable in the meantime; once the new version is ready, the path will start over from the beginning and your progress will be reset.
content_document_warning: Célestin will read this document and prepare the chapter again. The current content stays usable in the meantime; once the new version is ready, the path will start over from the beginning and your progress will be reset.
content_source_hint: Fix what Célestin misread, especially the passages marked {uncertain} or {illegible}. The “{page}” marks show the pages.
content_source_running: A preparation is already running for this chapter.
content_source_start_failed: The preparation couldn't be started. Try again.
content_picker_label: The PDF or photos of the course
content_picker_hint: A PDF, or one photo per page, in order. Take each page flat, well lit and fully in the frame. Handwritten notes and answer keys are welcome. {pages} pages and {size} at most.
content_picker_pdf_unchecked: The number of pages will be checked when you send it.
content_picker_too_many: {max} pages at most per chapter. Split the document up.
content_picker_type_refused: “{name}” is neither a PDF nor a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
content_picker_one_pdf: Choose a single PDF, or photos only.
content_picker_send_failed: The document couldn't be sent. Try again.
content_field_exercises: Exercises from the content (one per line, starting with their number, like “6.1.2”)
content_field_pack: Parts of the content used (one per line, like “§4.2”)
content_done_too_long: The completion criterion: {max} characters at most.
content_path_title_too_long: The path title: {max} characters at most.
content_beats_min: A lesson has at least one step.
content_exercises_min: Give at least one exercise from the content.
content_sections_min: The path has at least one section.

match.countPlural=one: Its {count} chapter, its content and your progress will be erased. This can't be undone.
match.countPlural=other: Its {count} chapters, their content and your progress will be erased. This can't be undone.

match.countPlural=one: Read from the document you uploaded ({count} page). The file isn't kept.
match.countPlural=other: Read from the document you uploaded ({count} pages). The file isn't kept.

lesson_mode_path_title: Move through the chapter, section by section
lesson_mode_discussion_title: Ask your questions about this chapter. Your progress doesn't move here.
lesson_transcript_open: See the whole conversation with Célestin
lesson_transcript_description: Everything you have said to each other in this session.
lesson_reset_description: Your progress in this chapter will be erased from your account and a new session will start at the first section.
lesson_reset_failed: The chapter couldn't be reset. Try again in a moment.
lesson_max_rounds: Célestin went on for too long and the answer was cut short. Ask again if you need to.
discussion_failed: The discussion couldn't be opened. Try again in a moment.
discussion_new_description: The current discussion won't be accessible any more. Your progress on the path isn't affected.
lesson_dictation_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser, then try again.
lesson_dictation_empty: I didn't hear anything. Try again, or write your message.
lesson_dictation_failed: Dictation didn't work. Try again, or write your message.
lesson_photo_open: Attach a photo of my work
lesson_photo_hint: Read what I read and correct it before sending. The parts in [brackets] are the ones I'm not sure about.
lesson_photo_empty: I couldn't read anything in this photo. Take it again, closer and well lit, or type your work.
lesson_photo_failed: The photo couldn't be read. Try again, or type your work.
lesson_photo_not_image: Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
lesson_webcam_description: Put your sheet in front of the camera, well lit and flat, then take the photo.
lesson_webcam_denied: The camera is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or choose an image.
lesson_webcam_none: No camera could be opened. Choose an image instead.
voice_time_left: Time left in the voice session
voice_phase_working: Célestin is writing on the board
voice_mic_denied: Célestin can't access your microphone. Allow it in your browser, then try again.
voice_connect_failed: The voice connection didn't work. Try again, or write to Célestin.
voice_busy_elsewhere: A voice session is already open in another tab.
voice_tool_failed_entry: The board couldn't be updated. Célestin carries on without it.
voice_realtime_error: Célestin had a voice connection problem. Célestin is carrying on.
board_empty: The board is empty. Célestin will write on it.
board_next_wait: Célestin will tell you when to move on.
describe_figure_axes_grid: Orthonormal coordinate plane, with a grid
describe_figure_hatched: Hatched part: what does not fit
describe_figure_layout_nested: Sets nested inside one another, from largest to smallest
describe_plot_axis_horizontal: Horizontal axis, from {from} to {to}, marked every {step}.
describe_plot_axis_horizontal_titled: Horizontal axis {title}, from {from} to {to}, marked every {step}.
describe_plot_axis_vertical: Vertical axis, from {from} to {to}, marked every {step}.
describe_plot_axis_vertical_titled: Vertical axis {title}, from {from} to {to}, marked every {step}.
describe_flowchart_too_wide: This flowchart is too wide for this screen; here it is step by step.
auth_registration_closed_body: New accounts can't be created right now. If you already have an account, sign in.
auth_register_verification_note: New accounts are checked by an administrator: you will be able to sign in once yours is enabled.
auth_pending_body: An administrator has to enable your account before you can sign in. Come back a little later.
settings_password_help: Changing it signs you out of your other devices.
admin_subtitle: Enable or disable accounts and reset passwords.
admin_mode_verification: On approval: new accounts stay disabled until an administrator enables them.
admin_mode_help: Set with REGISTRATION_MODE in the server's configuration.
admin_disable_body: This account will be signed out everywhere and will not be able to sign in until you enable it again. Its courses are kept.
admin_reset_body: A new temporary password will be generated and shown once. The current password stops working and the account is signed out everywhere.
admin_password_body: Give this password to its owner. It will not be shown again. They can change it in Settings once signed in.
admin_load_failed: The accounts could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
settings_ai_help: Célestin talks to an AI provider you choose: OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, or a server of your own such as Ollama. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
settings_ai_status_not_ready: Célestin can't teach yet: a role below still needs a model or a key.
settings_ai_preset_ollama_note: Runs on your own machine. From a Docker container, use http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1.
settings_ai_url_help: The address of an OpenAI-compatible API, usually ending in /v1.
settings_ai_key_stored: A key is stored (ends with {last4}). Leave the field empty to keep it.
settings_ai_key_environment: The key comes from the server's environment (ends with {last4}). It can't be changed here.
settings_ai_key_optional: A server on your own machine often needs no key.
settings_ai_key_unreadable: A key was stored but can't be read any more (the encryption key changed). Enter it again.
settings_ai_key_url_warning: The address changed: the stored key will be removed, because it was given for another server.
settings_ai_cannot_store: This server has no secrets directory, so it can't store a key. Set OPENAI_API_KEY in its environment instead.
settings_ai_style_help: Pick Chat Completions for a server that has no Responses API.
settings_ai_structured_help: JSON mode is for models that cannot be held to a schema: preparing chapters checks and repairs what they return.
settings_ai_role_tutor_help: Teaches and answers in the lesson. It must be able to call tools.
settings_ai_role_authoring_help: Turns a document into a course. It must be able to follow a JSON schema.
settings_ai_role_transcription_help: Reads the pages of a document. It must accept images.
settings_ai_role_voice_help: Talks with the student. It needs an OpenAI Realtime server.
settings_ai_model_required: Type the model's name: this provider has no default.
settings_ai_role_needs: This role still needs a model or a key.
settings_ai_voice_off: Voice is off: it needs OpenAI as the provider, or a provider of its own for this role.
settings_ai_own_toggle: Use a different provider for this role
settings_ai_models_listed: {count} models listed from the saved connection. Pick one in the model fields.
settings_ai_models_none: This server did not list its models: type the name.
settings_ai_models_failed: The server could not be asked. Check the address and the key, and save first.
settings_ai_saved_incomplete: Saved. Something is still missing: see the roles above.
settings_ai_test_connection_unreachable: the server could not be reached
settings_ai_test_limited: The server accepts the connection but does not list its models, so availability is unknown.
settings_ai_live_label: Also run a live check on each role (uses a few thousand tokens)
settings_ai_live_rejected: live check: the server refused the key
settings_ai_live_unreachable: live check: the server did not answer in time
settings_ai_live_model_not_found: live check: the server does not know this model
settings_ai_live_no_tool_calls: live check: this model does not call tools. Pick another for this role.
settings_ai_live_tool_arguments: live check: this model calls tools but gets the board's tool wrong. Pick another for this role.
settings_ai_live_no_image_input: live check: this model does not read images. Pick a vision model.
settings_ai_live_schema_unsupported: live check: this model does not follow a JSON schema. Try « JSON mode ».
settings_ai_live_other: live check failed for another reason
settings_ai_model_hidden: model not found on this server
admin_ai_banner: Célestin has no AI provider yet: nobody can start a lesson.
usage_link_help: Who calls the models, which one, at what cost.
usage_subtitle: Calls to the AI models: who makes them, with which model, and what the provider says about them.
usage_cost_coverage: Calls with a cost reported by the provider: {costed} of {calls}.
usage_cost_none: The provider does not report a cost.
usage_detail_failed: The details could not be loaded.
usage_failed: The usage could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
usage_period_invalid: The end date is before the start date: the period has no end.
